💡 Frequently Asked Questions

What should a Software Engineer put on a resume?

Highlight quantifiable engineering impact (e.g. latency reduction, scale handled, cost savings), key programming languages, system design experience, and open source or architectural contributions.

How many pages should a software engineer resume be?

A 1-page resume is optimal for engineers with under 8 years of experience. Keep bullet points punchy and start with strong technical action verbs.
